Lena Ortiz: Draft Optimize launch blog uploaded. Need: 1) quick editorial tone sweep, 2) legal check on the benchmark claim, 3) HubSpot CTA + lead routing mapping. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/optimize-launch-draft

Tom Bradford: on it. i'll do hero variants and short social snippets.

Maya Chen: thanks Tom. Benchmarks are currently: '20-40% lower per-token cost via caching + batching'. added appendix with test harness.

legal-bot: Automated scan: flagged comparative language. Please include test context (model, seq_len_p95, hardware) and avoid 'guarantee' or absolute phrasing.

Lena Ortiz: will add footnote with test params. Also want a short customer quote above the benchmarks 15 words.

Kevin O'Neill: HubSpot form id we should use: `hs_form_id=24680`. CTA URL should include utm_source=blog, utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=optimize_q3.

Lena Ortiz: adding UTMs. For lead routing, propose rules below 12 lines to paste into ops playbook:
```
# HubSpot routing pseudocode
if attended and (watched_pct >= 50 or demo_request == true):
  assign_to: sales-sdr
  tags: [optimize_launch, webinar_hot]
  priority: high
elif registered:
  nurture_flow: product_webinar_nurture
  tags: [optimize_launch]
```

Tom Bradford: hero options in the doc: 1) "Cut inference cost. Keep output quality." 2) "Spend less on inference, not less on results." 3) "Faster, cheaper inference for production." Leaning to #1.

Maya Chen: Ops asked if we should include example throughput per GPU in the post (for enterprise readers). I added a small example table and flagged it as "typical; results vary."

ops-bot: Confirmed. Throughput examples ok; recommend adding caveat: 'Results vary by model, prompt length, and hardware.'

legal-bot: For claims, please use phrasing: "Typical 20-40% per-token cost reduction observed in our internal tests; results vary by model and prompt length." Add footnote: model=llama-3-13b, seq_len_p95=512, batching=dynamic, runs=10, hardware=A100-80GB.

Lena Ortiz: updated phrasing and appended footnote. Also created placeholder customer quote: "Redwood Optimize cut our inference bill and kept latency tight." Tagging AE for real quote.

Kevin O'Neill: i'll set up HubSpot form + webhook once legal gives quick-pass. Planning to map registrants to list 'Optimize_Q3' and tag 'optimize_webinar'.

Tom Bradford: added two-line social shareables under 'shareables' in the doc. Shortened hero to Tom's pick with em-dash.

Lena Ortiz: Plan: finish edits now, request legal quick-pass, then aim for publish slot tomorrow 10:30 PT. Any other blockers?

Maya Chen: none here. i'll confirm ops numbers in the doc and ping AE for the quote.

legal-bot: Quick-pass pending final doc link.

Kevin O'Neill: once legal ok, i'll provision HubSpot mappings and post-live utm checks.

Lena Ortiz: thanks all. ping me when legal clears and I'll request the publish slot. :rocket:
